crop.notes: Column of base ball and sporting brevities; only one paragraph (crop-1) is about Allen

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican noted that Tom Allen, who was to spar with Tom Kelly at the Union grounds' Fourth of July tournament, said a score of local boxers would compete for the middle- and heavyweight prizes.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Thursday Morning, June 26, 1884, p. 6

facts.fact: Allen was billed to spar the wind-up with Tom Kelly, ex-middleweight champion, at the Union Club's Fourth of July tournament, both in full ring costume, for the Union Club Cup
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, St. Louis

notes: Allen's claim about local boxers is paraphrase, not a direct quote.
